func/events:
Functions: changeTellorContract(address); changeDeity(address); changeOwner(address)
Events: NewTellorAddress(address); NewProposedOracleAddress(address,uint256); NewOracleAddress(address,uint256)
description: Alerts when a successful implementation, owner, deity, or oracle change does not exactly match a valid approved-change record and the required post-state.

func/events: Events: BridgeStateUpdated(uint8); PauseProposed(uint256,address,uint256); PauseApproved(uint256,address,uint256); DataBridgeUpdated(address); RoleUpdateProposed(bytes32,address,uint256); RoleUpdateAccepted(bytes32,address); MintToOracleFailed()
description: Alerts when a bridge pauses; a role or DataBridge change is unapproved or unenrolled; a DataBridge post-state differs; or a new MintToOracleFailed failure period starts.

func/events:
EVM events: ValidatorSetUpdated(uint256,uint256,bytes32); GuardianResetValidatorSet(uint256,uint256,bytes32)
State reads: lastValidatorSetCheckpoint(); powerThreshold(); validatorTimestamp(); unbondingPeriod()
Layer: validator checkpoint endpoints
description: Alerts on every guardian reset, a persistent Ethereum-to-Layer validator mismatch, a non-increasing validator timestamp, or the exact unusable stale-state boundary.

func/events:
EVM events: Deposit(...); Withdraw(...); ExtraWithdrawClaimed(address,uint256); ExtraWithdrawClaimed(uint256,address,uint256); TokensToClaimUpdated(...); ExtraWithdrawReverified(...); Transfer(address,address,uint256)
Layer events: deposit_claimed; tokens_withdrawn; aggregate_report
description: Alerts when a finalized deposit, withdrawal, claim, or bridge token outflow cannot be reconciled exactly across Ethereum and Tellor Layer. A delay or an absence alone does not cause an alert.

func/events:
Event: NewReport(bytes32,uint256,bytes,uint256,bytes,address)
Replay: historical eth_call for supported EVMCall queries
description: Alerts when a known report is structurally non-canonical or an exact finalized historical EVMCall replay proves that successful non-empty return bytes differ.

func/events:
Event: OracleUpdated(bytes32,(bytes32,(bytes,uint256,uint256,uint256,uint256,uint256),uint256))
Reads: getAggregateValueCount(bytes32); getAggregateByIndex(bytes32,uint256)
Layer: retrieve_data
description: Alerts when an accepted update differs from its indexed query ID, append count, stored record, or fixed-query decoder. It reads Tellor Layer data once. If that read differs, it reads the data again. It alerts for a Layer-data mismatch only if the second read still differs.

func/events:
EVM events: NewDispute(uint256,bytes32,uint256,address); ValueRemoved(bytes32,uint256)
Layer event: new_dispute
description: Alerts once when an Ethereum NewDispute, an isolated ValueRemoved fallback, or a Tellor Layer new_dispute opens for a query and report timestamp.

func/events:
EVM event: Transfer(address,address,uint256) from the zero address
Trace functions: mintToOracle(); mintToTeam(); migrate()
Layer events: mint_coins; inflationary_rewards_distributed
description: Alerts when an Ethereum mint path, recipient, amount, log, supply delta, or state transition is invalid. For Tellor Layer, alerts when a mint/reward event pair is invalid, missing, or unexpected. This includes events that appear before initialization or when the formula expects no positive pair.

func/events: Scheduled function: getDataBefore(bytes32,uint256) for the ETH/USD query
description: Alerts when two providers agree at a 12-confirmed block that no undisputed ETH/USD report exists or its age is greater than 14,400 seconds.

func/events: Scheduled function: getDataBefore(bytes32,uint256) for the AMPL/USD query
description: Alerts when two providers agree that no confirmed undisputed AMPL/USD report exists in the inclusive daily 00:00:00-00:30:00 UTC window.

func/events: Scheduled function: getDataBefore(bytes32,uint256) for the USPCE query
description: Alerts when two providers agree that no confirmed undisputed USPCE report exists from month start through 00:00:00 UTC on the final calendar day, inclusive.
